title: SAMPLE: Exploring programming with limited equipment
source_organization: PathBridge AI capstone demonstration — not an official source
content: SAMPLE ONLY: Original demonstration guidance, not verified program information. A student exploring programming can begin by writing step-by-step instructions for a simple task on paper. If school or library computers are available, ask staff about access and usage rules before planning practice sessions. A small project, such as describing how a quiz works, can help the student decide whether they enjoy breaking problems into steps. Ask a counselor or teacher about locally available learning opportunities. This document establishes no course availability, costs, admissions requirements, equipment entitlement, or career outcomes.
